text: HORIBA, Ltd. (TSE Prime code 6856) lists its top 10 shareholders as of 30 June 2026 as The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (trust account, 12.21%), Custody Bank of Japan, Ltd. (trust account, 7.47%), UBS AG London (3.98%), Atsushi Horiba (2.63%), Stichting Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn (a Dutch sector pension fund, 2.51%), State Street Bank and Trust Company (two accounts, 2.34% and 2.17%), HORIBA Raku-Raku Kai (2.02%), The Bank of Kyoto, Ltd. (1.97%) and its employee stock-ownership association (1.67%).
short: HORIBA is Tokyo-listed; its largest holders are trust banks (Master Trust 12.21%, Custody Bank 7.47%).
